title: Anthropic与AMD合作部署Claude Mythos至MI355X GPU，耗时仅三日
originalTitle: Anthropic says Claude Mythos got Claude running on AMD GPUs in about three days
summary: Anthropic宣布与AMD合作，通过AI自主完成Claude Mythos模型迁移至MI355X GPU硬件，耗时约三天。该硬件基于CDNA 4架构，配备288GB HBM3E内存和8TB/s带宽，峰值性能达10PFLOPS。
author: Diego Almada Lopez
